meta.title: Decatron for your own bot
meta.description: Your own streaming bot with your credentials and your brand. Waitlist open.

hero.titleB: with your credentials and your brand.
hero.description: Decatron gives you the full engine of a Twitch bot: commands, moderation, alerts, overlays and more. You bring your account and your application; we bring the infrastructure.
hero.note: No card needed. We will let you know when the first accounts open.

diagram.title: Your Twitch application
diagram.text: Your credentials and your bot account. Yours, not shared.

diagram.title: The Decatron engine
diagram.text: Commands, moderation, alerts, overlays and more. Always up to date.

diagram.title: Your bot, your brand
diagram.text: On your channels, with your limits and your identity.

what.title: A bot that works as yours, not as one more on the list.
what.body: Most bots share a single account and a single application across all their users. This is different: you register your own Twitch application, use your own bot account and manage your own channels. The engine is the same one we use every day at Decatron; the only thing that changes is that the account, the credentials and the brand are yours.

cards.title: Your credentials
cards.text: Your Twitch application and your bot account. If something happens to one account, the others are not affected.

cards.title: Your brand
cards.text: Your name and your logo on your pages and overlays, on the plans that include your own branding.

cards.title: Always up to date
cards.text: Every improvement to the engine reaches your account without you installing or updating anything.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.text: With your email. No passwords to remember.

steps.title: Connect your application
steps.text: We guide you step by step to register your Twitch application and link your bot account.

steps.title: Turn on what you need
steps.text: Choose the modules, adjust your plan limits and you are done.

includes.title: The whole bot, not a trimmed-down version.
includes.subtitle: These modules already work today on Decatron.

items.title: Commands
items.text: Default and custom commands, micro commands and a script editor.

items.title: Moderation
items.text: Word, link and spam filters, raid protection and history. Includes Twitch lead moderators.

items.title: Alerts and overlays
items.text: Event and sound alerts, on-screen chat, "now playing", shoutouts, timers and live match.

items.title: Song requests
items.text: Queue, a public page for your community and a player.

items.title: Live translation
items.text: Translated subtitles for your audience while you stream.

items.title: Tournaments and wheel
items.text: Sign-up, brackets and prizes; a wheel with giveaways.

includes.note: Some modules use artificial intelligence and consume credits. Each plan defines how many it includes.

who.title: Made for people who need more than a generic bot.

items.title: Streamers
items.text: They want their own bot, with their own account and their own identity.

items.title: Agencies and managers
items.text: They run several channels and need to manage them from one place.

items.title: Communities and brands
items.text: They want a bot with their name, even on their own domain.

trust.title: Security and data isolation by design.
trust.text: Every account is built separate from the others. We will share the details when we open.

form.title: Get in first.
form.text: We are opening accounts little by little. Leave your email and we will let you know when there is room.
form.useCase: What would you use it for?
form.consent: We will only use your email to tell you about this list. You can ask us to delete it at any time.
form.doneText: If the address is valid, we sent you a message to confirm your spot. If it does not arrive in a few minutes, check your spam folder.
form.errorGeneric: We could not register your email. Try again in a few minutes.
form.errorLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
form.errorBusy: We received many requests today and cannot send more emails. Please try again tomorrow.
form.errorCaptcha: Complete the security check and try again.

items.q: What do I need to get started?
items.a: A Twitch account for your bot and to register your own developer application. We guide you through every step.

items.q: Does it work with Kick and other platforms?
items.a: We are starting with Twitch. Kick and other platforms will come later.
There will be a short trial with limits. Plans will be paid and affordable; we have not published prices yet.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: It is planned for the paid plans.

items.q: What happens if I stop paying?
items.a: Your account is paused and your data is kept for a while so you can come back.

items.q: Is this the same as Decatron?
items.a: It uses the same engine, but with your credentials, your brand and your own channels.
There is no date yet. The waitlist is the way to hear about it first.

confirm.okTitle: Done, you are on the list
confirm.okText: We will write to you when we open accounts.
confirm.errorTitle: We could not confirm your email
confirm.errorText: The link is not valid or was already used. If we have not confirmed you yet, sign up again.

admin.title: Platform waitlist
admin.subtitle: People signed up from decatron.top. Only those who confirmed their email count.
admin.pendingHint: Pending = signed up but has not opened the email link yet. Do not count them as interested.
admin.byUse: What they would use it for
admin.deleteText: {{email}} will be removed from the waitlist. This cannot be undone.

tenants.title: Platform tenants
tenants.subtitle: Load each buyer's Twitch app. Secrets are write-only: they are never shown again.
tenants.legacy: This is the Decatron tenant: it uses the server configuration and is not edited here.
tenants.formHelp: It is checked against Twitch before saving. If Twitch rejects it, nothing is saved.
tenants.secretHint: Encrypted on save and cannot be viewed afterwards. To change it, load the app again.
tenants.redirectHint: Optional. Must be https and match the one registered in the Twitch app.
tenants.saved: App validated with Twitch and saved.
tenants.loadFailed: Could not load the tenant list.
tenants.removeText: {{name}}'s credentials will be deleted. Its Twitch connections will stop working until another app is loaded.

errors.generic: The operation could not be completed.
errors.twitch_rejected: Twitch rejected the Client ID or Client Secret. Nothing was saved.
errors.twitch_unreachable: Could not reach Twitch. Try again.
errors.invalid_client_id: The Client ID format is not valid.
errors.invalid_client_secret: The Client Secret format is not valid.
errors.invalid_redirect_uri: The redirect URL must be a valid https URL.
errors.tenant_one_legacy: The Decatron tenant is not edited here.
